one_liner: Single parent of a 6- and a 9-year-old, worried about being 40 hours short — actually exempt

notice.title: Action needed: report your qualifying hours

situation: 29-year-old single parent of two children, ages 6 and 9, working about 40 hours a month cleaning offices. Received an hours-reporting notice and is frightened of losing coverage because 40 is less than 80. Does not know the caretaker exemption exists.
